facts.fact: INTIC says the free government digital signature service SCDM, at assinadoravancado.gov.mz, lets accredited users sign and verify electronic documents and is in use.
facts.system: Sistema de Certificacao Digital de Mocambique (SCDM)

facts.fact: INTIC says SCDM is in use at more than 10 public institutions, including the Imprensa Nacional, the Supreme Court and the Balcao de Atendimento Unico, between mid-2023 and end-2024.
